output.english_question: Does our retail loan policy allowing the bank, at its option, to offer a switch to a fixed rate at reset conflict with RBI’s current rule for UCBs?
sub_queries: RBI UCB fixed rate reset switch offer rule retail loans
UCB pre-closure switch to fixed rate at reset regulatory requirement
UCB policy conflict fixed rate conversion at reset RBI circular
premises: The bank’s policy allows an optional switch to a fixed rate at the applicable reset date for retail loans.
There exists an RBI regulatory rule currently applicable to UCBs regarding fixed-rate switching at reset or similar interest rate modifications.
Whether such an optional policy conflicts depends on the content and applicability of the RBI rule to this scenario.
